scripts.build: tsup index.ts --format cjs && tsup runtime/runtime.ts --format esm --target esnext --outDir runtime --external manifold-3d --external opentype.js --external fs --no-splitting
scripts.pretest: npm run build && npm link && npm run compile-all
scripts.test: cd test && npx vitest run geometry.test.ts && npx vitest run source-location.test.ts && npx vitest run semantic.test.ts && npx vitest run parse-errors.test.ts
scripts.test:geometry: cd test && npx vitest run geometry.test.ts
scripts.test:source-location: cd test && npx vitest run source-location.test.ts
scripts.test:semantic: cd test && npx vitest run semantic.test.ts
scripts.test:parse-errors: cd test && npx vitest run parse-errors.test.ts
